records.rationale: Retain grouped hwsim NAN state as the dependency of the final emulator radio implementation. Intermediate band/timer fields are subsequently replaced by slot scheduling, locking and per-radio cluster state. No binary layout preservation is required. This is common configured simulator code, not physical-platform enablement.

Retain source split, internal header and composite module Makefile, preserving mac80211_hwsim.ko and its existing build entry. Retain channel/rate/cipher array compile-time consistency checks. Source movement includes native radar/background fields and subsequent stable fixes in renamed main source; do not replace native receive validation, stop serialization or virtio length checks with older ACK bodies. Historical global cluster state is superseded by final per-radio synchronization.

Retain late beacon/probe/S1G timestamp writing with explicit minimum-length checks and monitor delivery after timestamp population. This supports the actual hwsim radio and external medium path without the old shared abs_bcn_ts field. Native TX feedback lookup, rate validation, netgroup/radio isolation and skb cleanup remain. Final locked timestamp helpers supersede the initial unprotected offset reads. Native function deltas are recorded.

Retain absolute next-TBTT calculation to avoid cumulative drift, but correct the inherited clock-domain mismatch: the deadline is boottime while the ordinary beacon timer was monotonic. e26a8023bbbf selects CLOCK_BOOTTIME to match the converter and NAN timers. Existing positive beacon-interval setup and native stop/cancellation are retained. Host actual-callback tests verify 9000 interval/offset/suspend scenarios; old clock causes suspend-duration delay in 6000. No live suspend test.

Retain 16-TU slot scheduling across 512-TU discovery-window periods, band/window notifications and boottime timer basis. Subsequent changes replace cached current-channel state and add per-slot TX/RX/synchronization. The initial boottime conversion unit error is superseded by 5d69369e0920. Current slots are bounded 0..31 by mask/division; next-slot 32 deliberately advances the period. Role handling is supplied by the later synchronization commit.

Retain discovery-window TX gating, 256-us boundary quiet time, randomized deferred queue wake and synchronous cancellation of the resume timer before clearing the vif. Later peer/data scheduling extends the initial management-only implementation. This models radio availability for the configured emulator driver; it is not a cryptographic access check and no real-time scheduling guarantee is claimed.

Retain deriving NAN transmit channel from current TSF instead of the last timer update, superseded in final code by get_tx_chandef handling DW and further availability windows. Invalid channel yields skb release/drop. The quiet-time guard reduces but does not prove absence of scheduling races; no hardware or live-medium timing claim.

Retain receive gating by slot/channel and RX timestamps, including external-medium fallback; later synchronization fixes the historical rx_flags-versus-flag typo and adds initial scanning, and data-path support adds scheduled bandwidth checks. Supply the missed tsf_offset_lock around the no-netlink RX timestamp sample in 796fec2fadb1. Preserve native network-group isolation, frame bounds and userspace receive/stop mutex serialization.

Retain initialized spinlock around TSF-offset conversions, updates and timestamp writing, including the boottime nanoseconds-to-microseconds correction. Complete its missing RX sample coverage in 796fec2fadb1. The added lock surrounds only a scalar read and releases before state-lock/receive processing, retaining the sampled common simulation time and avoiding a new reverse state-lock nesting. All offset accesses were inspected; no KCSAN or concurrent runtime claim.

Retain per-radio NAN cluster selection, synchronization/beacon generation, bounded vendor-element/attribute parsing, scan/warmup phases, state/TSF locks and cluster-join notifications. This replaces the globally shared cluster shortcut and supports hwsim external medium simulation. Correct timer publication order in 796fec2fadb1: cluster ID and DW notification setting are initialized before slot timer activation. Host immediate-timer tests expose both old successful-start cases. Existing simulation limitations remain: only 2.4-GHz synchronization, approximate external-medium timestamps, limited scanning and no old-schedule sync beacon after merge or DW contention mitigation. Do not claim full Wi-Fi Aware conformance or RX/teardown concurrency verification.

Retain conditional allowance for two NAN_DATA interfaces and enlarge private if_limits storage to five entries. This is needed for the optional NAN path in the already configured hwsim driver; it does not enable NAN in the pinned Goldfish constructor or add a new platform. Five entries cover base, ADHOC, P2P-device, NAN and NAN_DATA limit categories.

Retain local/peer schedule callbacks, bounded fixed-size slot/map arrays and private copies under initialized state/peer locks. Missing channels are cleared and absent peer schedules reset state; copying channel definitions avoids retaining transient cfg80211 parser storage. This supplies the driver consumer for retained common schedule APIs. Source lock and ownership contracts were inspected; concurrent update correctness is not dynamically verified.

Retain NAN_DATA TX/RX, DW/further-availability channel definitions, committed-DW peer checks, NDI-to-NMI RCU relation and local/peer schedule matching. Data is withheld during DW; outside DW it requires compatible local/peer channels. RX rejects unsupported bandwidth indices and wider-than-scheduled frames. Driver queue wake remains gated; this is simulated availability rather than authentication. Existing MAC/key authorization paths are separate and retain native validation.

Retain multicast data availability requiring at least one peer and all peers on this vif to be available. Reuse per-peer schedule gating under atomic station iteration, excluding other vifs and missing TXQs. Prevents unconditional multicast on an unscheduled NAN data interface. It does not guarantee delivery or replace encryption/authorization checks; no multicast runtime test.

target_evidence: Configured MAC80211_HWSIM=m and Goldfish mac80211_create_radios/main.cpp are existing SDK radio consumers. Its buildCreateRadioMessage does not enable NAN; optional NAN interfaces are retained in the same driver to preserve common Android/runtime/vendor source contracts, not justified by an assertion that default SDK radios use them. See nan-supplicant-uapi.json for old draft userspace mismatch.
limitations: Kernel compilation does not validate synchronization conformance, RX/stop concurrency, peer lifetime, queue timing, external-medium behavior or live suspend.
No proof of an exploit is inferred from the corrected initialization/locking/clock defects. Role algorithms intentionally approximate NAN behavior; no external standard was accessed.
No future platform, new dependency modification or historical vendor binary layout is required.
